title: Subtree of another tree
statementMd:
Return whether the tree `sub` appears as a subtree (same structure and values, rooted at some node) of the tree `main`. The tree is given as a level-order list where `None` marks a missing child (like `[3, 9, 20, None, None, 15, 7]`); the helper `build_tree` in the solution shows how it is read, and in your function the argument is already that list.

**Example:** `is_subtree([3, 4, 5, 1, 2], [4, 1, 2])` returns `true`.
